answer: Each task’s nonce and scoring parameters are derived only after a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse, then bound to the agent’s prior commit-reveal commitment using domain-separated labels such as “ripple,” “canyon,” and “umber.” Because the pulse is unpredictable when commitments are submitted, a sybil swarm cannot precompute valid responses or cheaply farm them offline; admission costs and rate limits can further constrain multiplying identities.
